_comment: Temporary, narrowly scoped exceptions to the production dependency audit (scripts/audit/check-audit.mjs). Each one covers ONE advisory, ONE package, the listed versions and the listed dependency paths, until its expiry date (at most 30 days after it was added). Anything else at high or critical still fails CI. Why each one exists: docs/sprints/wine-intelligence-mega/CI_EXCEPTIONS_0042.md (E1).

exceptions.reason: ReDoS when compiling attacker-chosen extglob patterns. picomatch is only used by @parcel/watcher to compile its own ignore globs, and next-intl starts that watcher only for message extraction in development, which CELLR does not configure. Not reachable from production requests. No patched picomatch exists (4.0.7 is the newest release), and removing it breaks next build or leaves the same 4.0.7 loaded through pnpm hoisting.
exceptions.remove_when: A picomatch release above 4.0.7 fixes the advisory (or @parcel/watcher / next-intl stop using a vulnerable picomatch): upgrade, then delete this entry. On the expiry date the audit fails again; renewing needs an explicit owner decision, a new reachability check and a new date at most 30 days ahead.
